feature_name: Presigned PUT URL Program Resource Uploads
description: Implement a client-side upload flow for program brand assets using presigned PUT URLs. Instead of embedding file data in API requests, resources should be uploaded directly from the browser to cloud storage with server-side validation. This system should support logos, files, colors, and links as resource types.
functional_requirements: Create a signed-upload endpoint that generates presigned PUT URLs for secure client-side file uploads to cloud storage
Implement client-side upload logic in the UI modals that handles file selection, direct upload to storage, and progress tracking
Enforce server-side file size limits and validation before generating upload URLs
Update resource creation/update flows to store storage keys/URLs instead of embedded file data
Improve user-facing error handling with clear toast messages during upload and submission failures
Support all resource types (logos, files, colors, links) within the new upload-driven architecture
